reason: Fresh Product Experience Final Validation on Product PR #229 exact head b7b5dbbe427ceae5502d61c7d603521791488cc3 isolated a real Desktop-only native scanner RED after Element and Matrix materialization passed. The trusted desktop builder completed production dependency closure, packaged Node 22.23.1 verification, Parlant runtime sealing and rcedit custody, then tools/wp7/verify-native-binaries.js rejected six mature-OSS foreign-target PE resources because their upstream target semantics are not yet recognized. This authorization permits a narrow failure-first repair in the existing WP7 scanner seam: recognize the exact Microsoft node-pty ConPTY architecture directory contract and PyPA distlib launcher filename contract, while retaining fail-closed PE machine enforcement for Windows x64 and forbidding broad ignores, hashes, pruning, workflow changes or Product runtime changes.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, discard invalid paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().

nodePty.contract: The exact official v1.1.0 tree contains third_party/conpty/1.23.251008001/win10-arm64/{OpenConsole.exe,conpty.dll} and third_party/conpty/1.23.251008001/win10-x64/{OpenConsole.exe,conpty.dll}. The win10-arm64 and win10-x64 directory components are upstream architecture-qualified variants and must be interpreted as such only inside the exact node-pty ConPTY structure.

distlib.contract: Official distlib scripts.py _get_launcher() selects bits as 32 or 64 from Python pointer size, appends -arm only when get_platform() is win-arm64, and forms launcher resource names as <t|w><32|64>[-arm].exe. Therefore t32.exe and w32.exe are Windows 32-bit variants, t64-arm.exe and w64-arm.exe are Windows ARM64 variants, while t64.exe and w64.exe are Windows x64 variants when scanning for the win32/x64 target. Recognition is restricted to distlib launcher resources under the pip/_vendor/distlib package structure.

failureFirstCommit.requiredCausalRed: The new exact upstream-contract fixtures must fail against the authorization-merge baseline because node-pty win10-arm64 and distlib foreign launcher resources remain UNQUALIFIED_TARGET_LOAD_PATH and trigger WP7_NATIVE_MACHINE_NOT_X64 for a win32/x64 target.

reviewedCandidates.name: Existing WP7 native target inference and PE machine gate
reviewedCandidates.reason: The scanner already distinguishes foreign prebuild variants from target-qualified variants and keeps target PE machine verification fail-closed. Extending its provenance-aware inference is smaller and safer than adding another scanner.

reviewedCandidates.name: Microsoft node-pty v1.1.0 ConPTY target directories
reviewedCandidates.reason: The exact locked upstream tree owns win10-arm64 and win10-x64 architecture directories for the bundled ConPTY binaries; scanner classification should consume that mature OSS contract rather than infer from hashes or remove upstream resources.

reviewedCandidates.name: PyPA distlib launcher selector
reviewedCandidates.reason: distlib itself defines the 32/64 and -arm launcher naming semantics. Exact resource-name recognition preserves the upstream distribution and avoids a Yance launcher taxonomy.

reviewedCandidates.name: Broad third_party, pip, distlib or non-x64 exclusion; hash whitelist; resource pruning; second Yance scanner framework
reviewedCandidates.reason: These approaches would hide unrecognized executable surfaces, couple safety to volatile file hashes, mutate mature OSS payloads merely to satisfy a gate, or duplicate an existing scanner seam. They are forbidden.

retireOrAvoid: Do not exclude third_party, pip, distlib or architecture directories broadly.
Do not whitelist executable hashes or exact released file hashes as a substitute for target semantics.
Do not delete foreign mature-OSS resources from the trusted payload merely to make the scanner pass.
Do not weaken or bypass WP7_NATIVE_MACHINE_NOT_X64 for target-loadable files.
Do not create a second native scanner, executable inventory framework or generalized Yance architecture registry.

mandatoryFailureFirstContracts: On the exact authorization-merge baseline, an arm64 PE at resources/app/node_modules/node-pty/third_party/conpty/<version>/win10-arm64/OpenConsole.exe must causally RED because the existing scanner lacks this upstream target inference.
On the exact authorization-merge baseline, an arm64 PE at the same node-pty ConPTY structure ending in conpty.dll must causally RED for the same reason.
After repair, node-pty win10-arm64 OpenConsole.exe and conpty.dll must be INERT_FOREIGN_TARGET_VARIANT for a win32/x64 target, while win10-x64 variants remain target-qualified and PE-machine checked.
A non-x64 PE placed under the exact node-pty win10-x64 target directory must still fail with WP7_NATIVE_MACHINE_NOT_X64.
After repair, exact pip/_vendor/distlib t32.exe and w32.exe x86 resources and t64-arm.exe and w64-arm.exe arm64 resources must be INERT_FOREIGN_TARGET_VARIANT for a win32/x64 target.

Exact pip/_vendor/distlib t64.exe and w64.exe must remain Windows x64 target variants and remain PE-machine checked; a non-x64 PE under either target filename must fail with WP7_NATIVE_MACHINE_NOT_X64.
A deceptive near-match outside the exact node-pty ConPTY structure, or an unrecognized executable filename under distlib, must remain unqualified and fail closed when its PE machine is not x64.
Existing prebuilds-directory foreign/target tests must remain GREEN without weakening their semantics.
The reason code WP7_NATIVE_MACHINE_NOT_X64 and the underlying target-loadable PE machine gate must not be removed, downgraded or converted to warning-only behavior.
